messages.subject_clean: about portfolioData() function in fPortfolio package
messages.body_plain:
Dear sirs:

When I use your great package 'fPortfolio', I have a question.

The help file about the function portfolioData() describles the 'data'
argument as follows:

a time series or a named list, containing either a series of returns or
named
   entries ’mu’ and ’Sigma’ being mean and covariance matrix.

If I have 4 securities named "AA", "BB", "CC", and "DD".

I only have their expected returns and covariance data, but I have not
their returns time series data. How can I get the efficient frontier with
'fPortfolio'?

Thanks.

                                                              Yours
                                                              Rho Zhang
                                                              June 5th. 2013

messages.subject: stabledist
messages.body_plain:
Dear Martin Maechler,

 

I'm trying to install the stabledist package on R (operative System
Windows).

Every time I run the install.packages("stabledist") I get the same error
message:

 

Warning: unable to access index for repository
http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/pub/RWin/bin/windows/contrib/2.9

Warning message:

In getDependencies(pkgs, dependencies, available, lib) :

  package 'stabledist' is not available

 

Could you please help me I need this package urgent.

 

Kind Regards,

 

Stefan Hummel
